summary: Tony lookout: a 1963 Canada Lookouts entry for Tony Creek may or may not match the register's 2005 steel tower, which is listed as active with fly access.

access.note: Register lists the tower as active with access mode fly (not road). The brief's 'closed' is not stated by any source read. No source describes public visits.

facts.agency: Wildfire staff with Agriculture and Forestry, Government of Alberta

events.note: Canada Lookouts entry for Tony Creek, under Whitecourt Division: 'A tower erected.' Matched to the register TONY by name only; may be an earlier tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Canada Lookouts entry (1963) and the register (2005) may describe different towers. The only link is the name Tony Creek versus TONY, so the story does not treat the 1963 tower as the same structure.

corrections.why: The register lists the tower as active with access mode fly. No source read says the tower is closed to the public.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one line from a hobby transcription site (Tony Creek, Whitecourt Division) and the register. The name match is unverified; the register's coordinates (54.405346, -117.491473) were not checked against Tony Creek. No newspaper or other source on this tower was found in two searches. Brief's 'closed' access is not supported by any source read; recorded as restricted. Agency uses the alberta.ca wording. No photos found.
